Each turn, Horla gains a stack of Metaphor for each emotion EXCEPT the Emotion she's currently in. (Example: If in Joy Stance, Anger, Grief and Fear gain a stack, but Joy will not and will never as long as she stays in Joy.) When switching Stances via her Leap effect, she consumes that Emotion's Metaphor stacks to gain a bonus effect of the corresponding Emotion (Anger = additional attacks, Grief = Healing, Fear = Strength, Joy = Aliemus) The more stacks you have, the stronger the effect, up to 3 stacks for each Emotion.

Personally i like her Rouse, as you can gain a lot of Aliemus when switching to Joy, or a lot of Strength from her Fear, but that requires micromanaging her Leap effects and that can be hard to do when prioritizing what you want to put in to Ultra Space and even harder to do if you don't have her E2. Not only that but her Rouse is just not as important compared to the other members on your team. She's usually the last memeber you'll Rouse, if ever.
